how: Drawn by eye by a Claude agent on 2026-11-24, before any picture of the fix was rendered. Each 1024x1024 CO3 picture from Z2's full run (copied read-only from /datasets/mmolefe/poe_repair_min/loop-12/z2/full/<pair>/seed-<seed>.png) was read at full size with a labelled 64-pixel grid over it, and one axis-aligned box was drawn around each animal's whole visible body (head, tail, legs, plumes), excluding water reflections and shadows. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in picture pixels; divide by 8 for the 128x128 latent. A is the first animal in the pair name and B the second. Each box is assigned by body shape: an animal wearing the other's head or markings keeps the label of the body it has, and the note says what it borrowed. layout is 'two' when the picture holds exactly one A body and one B body, and 'not_two' when it holds two of one animal, no body of one animal, or an extra animal; then only the boxes that can be given are filled, and the extra animals' boxes are written in the note. Every box was checked on the contact sheets boxes-<pair>.png.
